subdivision_of_building: Rear freezer and chilled storage room and rear covered loading and storage area
decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location Plan 1:1250MH/HLE2/P01MH/HLE2/P02MH/HLE2/P03MH/HLE2/P04CIL formSupporting Statement February 2025Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

No development shall take place (other than site clearance) until a Construction Management Plan (CMP) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Construction of the permitted development must be undertaken in accordance with the approved plan. The CMP shall include, but not be limited to, arrangements for the following in respect of each phase of the works:Site Access and Logistics:   - Details of any temporary construction access to the site, including measures for removal following completion of construction works.   - Anticipated vehicle numbers, types, and frequencies.   - Access and routing of vehicles during construction.   - Measures to manage the delivery of materials and plant to the site, including the routes and timings of deliveries and provision of loading/unloading areas.Site Management:   - Parking areas for contractors' vehicles.   - Areas for storage of plant and materials used in constructing the development, clear of the highway.   - Erection and maintenance of security hoarding.Environmental Safeguards:   - Wheel washing facilities on site to ensure that mud and debris are not spread onto the adjacent public highway.   - Other means to mitigate the impact on the public highway.   - Measures to minimise dust, noise, and vibration.Construction Operations:   - A detailed method statement and programme for the building works.   - Hours of work.   - Details of public engagement.Contact Information:   - Contact details for the responsible person (site manager/office) who can be contacted in the event of any issue.The approved CMP shall be adhered to and implemented throughout the construction period, in accordance with the approved details, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.Reason: To protect the environment of neighbouring occupiers.

The development shall not be occupied until details of the development site southern boundary treatment have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. These details shall include ground levels of the application site as well as ground levels of bordering gardens of properties on Osborne Road, boundary treatment heights, materials and method of installation.  Construction of the boundary treatment must be undertaken in accordance with the approved details.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and amenity of neighbouring properties.

No plant or equipment shall be affixed to any external face of the development or added to the roof of the development other than in accordance with approved drawings.Reason: In the interest of amenity and to ensure a satisfactory external appearance in accordance with policy D4 of the London Plan (2021), CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010) and DMD37 of the Enfield Development Management Policy (2014).

Prior to occupation of the development, details of refuse storage facilities to be provided within the development should be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The facilities shall be provided in accordance with the approved details. Reason: In the interests of amenity.

Details of any external lighting within 15 metres of the southern boundary of the development site (i.e. the boundary with properties fronting Osborne Road) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority before the extension hereby permitted is occupied. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.Reason: To protect the environment of neighbouring occupiers.
